summary: New Horizon Aircraft Ltd. filed a prospectus supplement (424B5) for a registered direct offering of 9,254,889 Class A ordinary shares at $2.15 per share, alongside placement agent warrants. The offering is anticipated to yield net proceeds of approximately $18.5 million before expenses, with Titan Partners Group acting as sole placement agent. Shares are listed on Nasdaq under ticker HOVR, with a last reported price of $2.81 on May 6, 2026. This transaction is a standard capital raise via a shelf registration; it does not constitute a special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring.
